reason: Hyperphosphatemia and seizures support the metabolic_endocrine and neurologic axes. Polyuria alone does not establish renal damage.
The carcinoma originates in the lacrimal gland, within the ocular axis. A salivary-gland origin associated with other adenoid cystic carcinomas does not apply.
Carotid-body paraganglionic origin supports neurologic and metabolic_endocrine. Neither adjacent carotid vessels nor unspecified metastatic sites justify additional axes.
Frontonasal skeletal malformation and cloacal exstrophy support musculoskeletal, renal and gastrointestinal primary axes. The sparse evidence warrants low confidence.
Ectodermal abnormalities, deafness and finger contractures define the syndrome. Cognitive impairment occurs in 30–79%; prioritizing it over dental disease under the four-axis cap is reasonable.

Vitreoretinal disease defines the ocular primary axis. Pulmonary abnormalities and enamel hypoplasia occur in 2/2; neurologic abnormalities in 1/2 support involvement. The tiny sample and omitted cardiac finding are acknowledged.

HSV infection directly damages the brain, requiring neurologic and infectious_immune primary axes. Skin disease is not defining, and ventilation or electrolyte abnormalities do not establish additional direct organ damage.

Motor/autonomic neuropathy and defining achalasia support neurologic and gastrointestinal primary axes. Muscle atrophy in 80–99% supports musculoskeletal involvement; autonomic hypotension does not establish cardiovascular tissue damage.

Neurodevelopmental impairment defines the neurologic axis. Visual impairment in 8/15 supports ocular involvement; scoliosis in 5/17 is approximately 30%, making musculoskeletal involvement a reasonable medium-confidence inclusion.

Add haematologic to primary: the defining T-lymphocyte developmental and functional defect is a blood-cell disorder, requiring this mechanism axis alongside infectious_immune. Associated respiratory infections remain separate diseases.

corrected.basis: Combined immunodeficiency with a defining T-lymphocyte defect and reduced CD4/CD8 populations supports immune and blood-cell axes. Associated respiratory infections are separate diseases.
